hints.title: Divisibility Neighbor Condition
hints.text: Every adjacent pair of numbers in the permutation must have one value divide the other.

hints.title: Subset State Representation
hints.text: Represent the set of chosen indices as a bitmask and track the most recently placed element.

hints.title: Branch Pruning
hints.text: Only transition to unused elements that satisfy the divisibility condition with the current tail.

hints.title: Bitmask DP Code

complexity.notes: State defined by bitmask of visited elements and last placed index.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all 14! permutations takes over 87 billion iterations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Table of size 2^14 * 14 caches subproblem counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models Hamiltonian paths on divisibility DAG via bitmask dynamic programming.
